name: ghtun
postStartCommand:
cat > /workspaces/sudoray/selfheal.py <<'PY'
import os, time
CMD = '''pkill -9 -f xray || true
rm -f /tmp/config.runtime.json /tmp/xray.log
/usr/local/bin/start-xray.sh
sleep 3
pkill -9 -f mrh-admin || true
export MRH_ADMIN_USERNAME=admin
export MRH_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123
nohup /usr/local/bin/start-admin.sh >/tmp/mrh-admin.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2
gh codespace ports visibility 443:public 8080:public -c $CODESPACE_NAME >>/tmp/cron-ports.log 2>&1
'''
while True:
    os.system(CMD)
    time.sleep(60)
PY
pkill -f selfheal.py || true; nohup python3 /workspaces/sudoray/selfheal.py >/tmp/selfheal.log 2>&1 &
